free_tier.stated: No free tier. The vendor's own promo plan RED-PROMO is USD 1 a month plus a USD 20 one-time payment with 1 IPv4, a /48 IPv6 and 100 Mbps; the aggregator lists PROMO-Platinum at USD 0.5 a month.
free_tier.notes: The vendor home page read does not list a plan named PROMO-Platinum; the FAQ's promo-server figures are used. A separate 15 minute free server needs no registration or card.

egress.terms: No byte cap: all servers have a free unlimited internet connection on a shared basis, with guaranteed speeds in the terms; promo servers are guaranteed up to 100 Mbit/s (about 33 TB per 30 days) or up to 10 Mbit/s (about 3.2 TB per 30 days).
egress.free_allowance: unlimited on a shared basis; guaranteed speed up to 100 Mbit/s on promo servers

interface_detail: KVM VPS with root access, one IPv4 and a free /64 on-link IPv6; extra IPv4 at USD 2 a month each, up to 16.
tooling: Any SSH client; VNC console and OS reinstall in the control panel.
chaining: Dedicated IPv4 plus a /64 IPv6; mail ports TCP 25, 465 and 587 are blocked by default and can be unblocked by ticket; the FAQ states torrents are an allowed protocol.

limits.value: promo servers: guaranteed up to 100 Mbit/s (about 33 TB per 30 days) or up to 10 Mbit/s (about 3.2 TB per 30 days)

limits_note: Extra guaranteed bandwidth costs USD 80 or USD 120 per Gbit a month by location.
binding_note: No byte cap; the terms guarantee only a speed floor on a shared uplink.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: behind a sign-up. The home page links a sign up and sign in on a billing panel; the sign-up form was not readable.

reliability_note: The promo plan has no technical support, no RAID and no data-safety guarantee; refunds are limited to 24 hours after activation.
confidence_note: FAQ figures are first-party and cover promo servers in general; the PROMO-Platinum plan and its price are aggregator values the vendor home page does not list.
